snippet.title: As We Unite - Analog Geopolitical Strategy Sim - Short Gameplay (Steam)
snippet.description:
As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a high-ranking Consul of a secretive cult aiming to unite the world before an impending global calamity. Instead of controlling a country, you manage agents across different nations, each run has a crisis you have to resolve!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678350/As_We_Unite/
